steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Open the Events list before creating the event.
Verify the Events list and Create Event control rendered.
Verify the Create Event menu offers the required Single Stage path.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Provide the mandatory event title so publishing can proceed.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add a product so the pricing sheet and schedule controls are available.
Complete the pricing sheet required for publication.
Invite one available QA vendor as required for publication.
Open the Schedule Event drawer from the footer schedule control.
Record the schedule drawer’s calculated end-time line before saving.
Choose the required four-hour duration while keeping the default Start now setting.
Verify the footer schedule chip shows the selected four-hour duration.
Publish the configured RFQ and confirm the publish flow.
Verify publication reached a real project page.
Verify the published Project Details end-time value matches the end time recorded in the schedule drawer.
